subject.title: feat(feeds): search and follow signed publisher feeds

question: Should signed publisher-feed discovery, follows, and durable refresh be a permanent OpenClaw core CLI/state feature, or should this workflow move to a ClawHub/plugin-owned package using existing extension seams?
rationale: The patch adds a broad core CLI, network-trust client, and shared SQLite state for a service-specific workflow; repository policy makes that ownership boundary a maintainer product choice rather than a mechanical review decision.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded core primitive
options.body: Confirm that signed publisher-feed following is a core platform capability, define its stable ownership and upgrade contract, then require live end-to-end proof before merge.

options.title: Move the workflow to an extension
options.body: Keep only any genuinely missing generic core seam and publish the feed-specific client, storage, and CLI workflow through ClawHub or a plugin.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a bounded core primitive
recommendation.body: Confirm that signed publisher-feed following is a core platform capability, define its stable ownership and upgrade contract, then require live end-to-end proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the active implementation series and can supply the intended architectural rationale and concrete proof for maintainer review.
